title: Minuteman silos on Black Hills land guaranteed by the Fort Laramie treaty

tellings.quote: 150 Minute Man silos were sunk into land that was guaranteed to the great Sue Nation by the 1868 Fort Laram treaty.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that 150 underground launch sites for Minuteman nuclear missiles were dug into land in South Dakota's Black Hills region. He points out that this land had been promised to the Great Sioux Nation, a group of Native American peoples, by the 1868 Fort Laramie Treaty, an agreement with the US government, and he raises it as backdrop to stories of strange events around those missile bases.
